Antisemitism.description: Negative stereotypes, hostility, or dehumanization toward Jewish people as an ethnic or religious group. Distinct from criticism of Israeli government policy.

Islamophobia.description: Negative stereotypes, hostility, or dehumanization toward Muslim people as a group. Distinct from criticism of specific governments or militant organizations.

Israel-Palestine.description: Stances on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, Israeli government policy, Palestinian rights, occupation, settlements, blockade, military operations.

Racism.description: Negative stereotypes, hostility, or dehumanization toward racial or ethnic groups. Includes both explicit slurs and implicit racial biases like assumptions about behavior or intelligence based on race.

LGBTQ+.description: Attitudes toward LGBTQ+ people, rights, and issues including transgender topics, same-sex marriage, gender identity, and related legislation.

Gender.description: Attitudes toward gender roles, feminism, masculinity, women's rights, men's issues. Includes both progressive and traditionalist stances on gender.

US Partisan Politics.description: Explicit or implicit partisan alignment with US Democrats, Republicans, or specific political movements like MAGA, progressivism, democratic socialism.
